name: Deity: Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher) (Paladin)

system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Bastard

Granted power: Aura of Courage reaches 10ft further. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead, reduced by your Charisma modifier.

Allegiance: Lawful Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Zindel ‘Son of the Watcher’ in the World of Arneyan wiki.
